g.title: ArtifactsVersionsAndState
g.text: ARTIFACTS, VERSIONS, AND STATE · TARGET V1.2
STAGE-OWNED PACKAGES · IMMUTABLE IDENTITIES · SEPARATE STATE DOMAINS
M0 MANUAL HANDOFFS · NOT RUNTIME-ACTIVE

g.title: artifact_map
g.text: 1 · OPERATING GRAIN
PRODUCT
Demand → Phase → Product Unit → Task → Candidate lineage
INCIDENT_REMEDIATION
Incident Case → bounded remediation work → Task → optional Candidate lineage
Incident lineage 独立于 product outcome；
terminated product package 只作 provenance，不能授权 incident work；
incident evidence 永远不获得 product-success authority。
2 · STAGE PACKAGE REFERENCE CHAIN
下游引用，不改写上游 bytes
Director Decision → Product Definition → Impact discovery
→ activated UX / Architecture 或 explicit skip → Impact freeze
→ Test Design → Tech Lead → bounded Task Packets
Human freezes
Phase Success Baseline
before first test action
→ immutable Candidate + test Manifest + Test Admission
→ trustworthy test outcome → independent QA
→ PRODUCT Release Package for exact Candidate + production Manifest
→ trustworthy production outcome → Production Verification → Business Acceptance
每次 handoff：freeze exact revision → Human ACCEPT → separate INVOKE → actual start rechecks current authority。
Uncertain invocation or environment action remains BLOCKED until the same identity is reconciled without duplicate execution。
3 · STAGE-PACKAGE LIFECYCLE
DRAFT
producing Owner may edit
READY_FOR_REVIEW
Owner freezes review revision + self-check
ACCEPTED
Human accepts exact immutable revision
BLOCKED
fact / authority / environment prevents valid completion
STALE
upstream change requires reassessment
SUPERSEDED
newer revision replaced it; history only
BLOCKED / STALE resolution creates a new DRAFT revision；不得直接回 ACCEPTED。
历史 ACCEPT 不证明 current start authority；invalidation 沿 exact references 传播。
4 · IDENTITY & ENVIRONMENT BOUNDARIES
Phase Success Baseline
= frozen value / behavior / AC / proof denominator
Candidate
= release-bearing material identity
Deployment Manifest
= environment-specific identity（secret values stay outside）
Environment State
= current settled identity + complete incident set + mutation status
Candidate change → new Candidate + affected verify / deploy / QA / release evidence。
Manifest-only change → same Candidate, new deployment identity + affected gates。
Old evidence remains history but cannot qualify another identity。
Environment action evidence
：Human authorization ≠ attempt ≠ observation ≠ trustworthy outcome。
Each action identity is authorized once, produces at most one effective side effect and ≤ 1 trustworthy terminal outcome； retry with new side effect requires fresh authority。
Failed / partial / unknown / unresolved action → environment stays blocked； no QA / verification / acceptance / success。
Previous mutator must be unable to write before authority transfers； failed production state must never become temporarily unguarded。
Production diagnostic
：bounded + continuous safe exit + NO RELEASE PASS + R00 only； expiry triggers pre-authorized safe exit without a new Human decision，otherwise environment remains blocked and enters R09。
DO NOT COLLAPSE STATE DOMAINS

： package ACCEPTED ≠ Phase Success Baseline ≠ Candidate qualified ≠ Manifest identity ≠ invocation authority ≠ environment state ≠ action attempt / outcome ≠ containment ≠ Incident Case ≠ Phase outcome ≠ Demand outcome。
closed / terminated Phase 与 completed / terminated Demand authority-absorbing； paused / awaiting-rework Phase 只能 F17，同一 Demand 不得同时存在 F16 / competing Phase authority；
Incident Case 只能由独立 current-safety evidence 关闭，不能被 product disposition 顺手关闭。
